props.label: Name
props.description: Name - Label field

props.label: Process Offset Min
props.description: Time in minutes from start of process(or last qc if repeat) to begin QC check. For use with intraprocess intervals.

props.label: Process Offset Max
props.description: Time in minutes from start of process(or last qc if repeat) to begin QC check. For use with intraprocess intervals.

props.label: Shift Offset Min
props.description: Time in minutes from start of shift to begin QC check. For use with intrashift intervals.

props.label: Shift Offset Max
props.description: Time in minutes from start of shift to begin QC check. For use with intrashift intervals.

props.label: Quantity Min
props.description: The production quantity required to trigger qc check

props.label: Quantity Max
props.description: The production quantity required to trigger qc check

props.label: Custom
props.description: Is this a custom type interval. For use with customData JSON field

props.label: Intra Process
props.description: QC is during process (while product is actively being made). Typically used in conjunction with product/process quality subject and with process offset field. default=false.

props.label: Intra Shift
props.description: QC is during shift. This would typically used in conjunction with a workcenter subject and the shiftoffset field. default=false.

props.label: On Transaction
props.description: Is quality check triggered by transaction? For use with transactionType.

props.label: Post Process
props.description: QC  is after  process/process end. Typically used in conjunction with product/process quality subject. default=false.

props.label: Post Shift
props.description: QC at end of shift. This would typically used in conjunction with a workcenter subject. default=false.

props.label: Pre Process
props.description: QC is before process/ process start (default=false). Typically used in conjunction with product/process quality subject

props.label: Pre Shift
props.description: QC at beginning of shift. This would typically used in conjunction with a workcenter subject. default=false.

props.label: Repeat
props.description: The interval repeats (as per shiftoffset/ processoffset/ quantity). default=false

props.label: Custom Data
props.description: Used to define custom parameters associated with qualityInterval.
